# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 25 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all lines in Thanksgiving Hymns Column 25 where the three translators significantly diverged, along with SOPHIA's resolution.

---

## 25:2 — "reins" vs. "inner being" vs. "insides" — somatic distress vocabulary

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "my reins are dissolved" | Archaic "reins" for kelayot (kidneys as seat of emotion) |
| LOGOS | "my inner being is undone" | Modern equivalent preserving the somatic reference |
| PNEUMA | "my insides came apart" | Colloquial dynamic equivalent |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS. "Inner being" conveys the Hebrew sense without the archaic opacity of "reins" or the colloquial register of "insides."

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 25:5 — "abandoned" vs. "forsaken" vs. "cut off"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "I am abandoned" | Literal ne'ezvati |
| LOGOS | "I am forsaken" | Formal biblical register |
| PNEUMA | "I have been cut off" | Dynamic emphasis on covenant separation |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS. "Forsaken" carries the appropriate psalmic resonance (cf. Psalm 22:2) and is the standard biblical English rendering.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 25:9 — "lovingkindness" vs. "covenant faithfulness" vs. "faithful love"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "Your lovingkindness" | Traditional rendering of chesed |
| LOGOS | "Your covenant faithfulness" | Project convention for chesed |
| PNEUMA | "Your faithful love" | Accessible modern rendering |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS. Per established project convention (Gen 24 ruling), chesed is consistently rendered "covenant faithfulness."

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS. Per standing project convention.

---

## 25:10 — "purify" vs. "cleanse" vs. "wash clean" — purification vocabulary

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "You purify a man from guilt" | Literal thr in Piel |
| LOGOS | "You cleanse a person from guilt" | "Cleanse" as standard purification term |
| PNEUMA | "You wash a person clean of guilt" | Expanded dynamic rendering |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS. "Cleanse" is the standard rendering for ritual purification language in DSS translation. PNEUMA's "wash clean" over-specifies the metaphor.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 25:15 — "engraved" vs. "inscribed" vs. "written down" — predestinarian imagery

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "are engraved before You" | Emphasizes permanence of the divine record |
| LOGOS | "are inscribed before You" | Standard scholarly rendering |
| PNEUMA | "is written down before You" | Simplified for accessibility |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS. "Inscribed" preserves the formal register appropriate to the predestinarian theology without the overly specific "engraved" (suggesting stone rather than scroll).

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 25:22 — "sons of man" vs. "children of mortals" vs. "us mortals"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-sons-of man" | Literal bene 'enosh |
| LOGOS | "the children of mortals" | "Children" inclusive; "mortals" for 'enosh |
| PNEUMA | "us mortals" | First-person shift for devotional immediacy |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS. "Children of mortals" preserves the collective humanity reference. PNEUMA's first-person shift is not supported by the Hebrew grammar.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 25:25 — "line" vs. "measuring line" vs. "blueprint"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "upon a line" | Literal qav |
| LOGOS | "upon a measuring line" | Clarifies the architectural metaphor |
| PNEUMA | "on a blueprint" | Modern equivalent of the planning metaphor |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS. "Measuring line" is the recognized rendering of qav in prophetic and creation contexts (cf. Isa 28:17). PNEUMA's "blueprint" is anachronistic.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---
